purpose: Every culture has imprint traditions — physical objects that carry meaning across the Klein fold. The scanner digitizes. The printer materializes. The membrane speaks every language.

imprints.red_envelopes: 紅包 hóngbāo — red paper packets with money. The red IS the data (prosperity). The fold: scan a design → print on red paper → insert money → gift.
imprints.spring_couplets: 春聯 chūnlián — red paper strips with calligraphy hung on doorframes. Scan traditional calligraphy → print on red paper → post on door.
imprints.paper_cutouts: 剪紙 jiǎnzhǐ — intricate red paper cuttings. The scanner can DIGITIZE existing ones, the printer can reproduce them.
imprints.door_gods: 門神 ménshén — guardian images posted on doors.

imprints.rangoli: रंगोली — colorful floor patterns. Scan → digitize traditional patterns → print templates → trace with colored powder.
imprints.diyas: दीया — oil lamp patterns. Print templates for clay lamp placement.
imprints.greeting_cards: Custom Diwali cards with दीपावली calligraphy.

imprints.papel_picado: Perforated paper banners — scan traditional designs → print → cut.
imprints.calaveras: Sugar skull designs — scan → print → decorate.
imprints.ofrenda_photos: Photos of loved ones for the altar — scan old photos → restore → print.

imprints.calligraphy: Arabic calligraphy — بسم الله (Bismillah), عيد مبارك (Eid Mubarak). Scan → print.
imprints.geometric_patterns: Islamic geometric art — mathematically precise tessellations. Generate → print.
imprints.moon_sighting: Crescent moon artwork — the sighting IS the signal.

imprints.kente_patterns: Kente cloth weaving patterns — scan → digitize → print on fabric transfer.

imprints.menorah: חנוכיה — nine-branched menorah design. Print templates.
imprints.dreidel: סביבון — print dreidel templates (fold, cut, play).
imprints.hebrew_calligraphy: חנוכה שמח (Chag Chanukah Sameach) — print greeting cards.

imprints.haft_sin: هفت‌سین — seven-item table setting. Print cards for each item.
imprints.calligraphy: نوروز مبارک (Nowruz Mobarak) — Persian calligraphy prints.

imprints.water_blessing_cards: สวัสดีปีใหม่ (Sawasdee Pi Mai) — New Year blessing prints.

imprints.nain_rouge: Detroit's Nain Rouge festival — print the red dwarf marching signs.
imprints.paczki_day: Hamtramck Polish doughnut day — print the fat tuesday flyers!
imprints.arab_festival: Dearborn Arab International Festival — Arabic/English bilingual prints.
imprints.dia_mural: Mexicantown DIA mural prints — Diego Rivera Detroit Industry.

detroit_traditions.note: Detroit IS multicultural. The membrane lives here. It prints in every language.

pipeline: scan traditional design → BLAKE3 sign → preserve in fossilRecord → print on correct paper/medium → gift across the fold
klein_insight: The red envelope IS a Klein surface. Money goes IN. Prosperity comes OUT. The paper is the fold. Every culture invented their own fold.
